Here is a comprehensive report of the settings page structure in `apps/desktop/src`. --- ## Settings Page Structure ### 1. Entry Point and Layout **File:** `/Users/lxy/Documents/GitHub/LinXueyuanStdio/viben/apps/desktop/src/pages/settings/index.tsx` The `SettingsPage` component is the root. It implements a two-panel layout: - **Left sidebar nav** (`w-56` expanded, `w-16` collapsed) — collapsible state is persisted in `localStorage` via key `"settings-sidebar-collapsed"`. Collapsed mode shows icon-only buttons with tooltips; expanded shows icon + label. - **Right content area** — `flex-1 overflow-auto`. Padding (`p-6`) is conditionally omitted for full-width sections (`agents`, `mcp`, `skills`). Content max-width is `max-w-2xl` for normal pages; full height for list pages. - **Animated transitions** — `framer-motion` `AnimatePresence` with `mode="wait"`, slide-in/slide-out `x: ±20` (skipped when `prefers-reduced-motion`). Section routing is URL-driven: `/settings/
